name: @markgrafhq/markgraf-browser-extension
description: Browser extension that renders markgraf fenced code blocks live on GitHub (and other markdown surfaces).

scripts.build:content: spago build && purs-backend-es bundle-app -m Markgraf.Extension.Content --platform browser --to assets/content.js
scripts.build: bun run sync-embed && bun run sync-version && bun run build:content
